import pandas as pd

def load_and_transform_source(file_path: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """
    Load a source CSV file and ensure its schema and types match the target schema.
    """
    # Load the CSV
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

    # Enforce target schema and types explicitly:
    # Target Schema:
    # ['tripduration': int, 'starttime': str, 'stoptime': str,
    #  'start station id': int, 'start station name': str,
    #  'start station latitude': float, 'start station longitude': float,
    #  'end station id': int, 'end station name': str,
    #  'end station latitude': float, 'end station longitude': float,
    #  'bikeid': int, 'usertype': str, 'birth year': int, 'gender': int]

    # Convert columns to correct types
    df['tripduration'] = df['tripduration'].astype(int)
    df['starttime'] = df['starttime'].astype(str)
    df['stoptime'] = df['stoptime'].astype(str)
    df['start station id'] = df['start station id'].astype(int)
    df['start station name'] = df['start station name'].astype(str)
    df['start station latitude'] = df['start station latitude'].astype(float)
    df['start station longitude'] = df['start station longitude'].astype(float)
    df['end station id'] = df['end station id'].astype(int)
    df['end station name'] = df['end station name'].astype(str)
    df['end station latitude'] = df['end station latitude'].astype(float)
    df['end station longitude'] = df['end station longitude'].astype(float)
    df['bikeid'] = df['bikeid'].astype(int)
    df['usertype'] = df['usertype'].astype(str)
    df['birth year'] = df['birth year'].astype(int)
    df['gender'] = df['gender'].astype(int)

    # Return the transformed dataframe
    return df

def main():
    # List all source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_2/test_0.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_2/test_1.csv"
    ]

    # Load and transform all sources, then concatenate
    dfs = []
    for file_path in source_files:
        df = load_and_transform_source(file_path)
        dfs.append(df)

    # Concatenate all dataframes into one target dataframe
    target_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

    # Optional: reorder columns to exactly match target schema order
    target_columns = [
        'tripduration', 'starttime', 'stoptime',
        'start station id', 'start station name', 'start station latitude', 'start station longitude',
        'end station id', 'end station name', 'end station latitude', 'end station longitude',
        'bikeid', 'usertype', 'birth year', 'gender'
    ]
    target_df = target_df[target_columns]

    # Write the combined dataframe to the target CSV file
    target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_2/target_multisource_cot.csv", index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
